title: Hayotiy tajriba haqida gapirish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida present perfect, ever va never yordamida hayotiy tajribangiz haqida savol berasiz va javob berasiz hamda present perfect bilan past simple farqini to‘g‘ri qo‘llaysiz.

scenes.title: Hayotiy tajriba haqida
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Bugungi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda telefon, internet va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar haqida gaplashishni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa hayotingizda nimalar bo‘lganini aytishni o‘rganamiz: qayerda bo‘lgansiz, nimani tatib ko‘rgansiz, nimani hech qachon qilmagansiz. Dars oxirida o‘zingizning hayotiy tajribangiz haqida savol-javob qila olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello! Today we will talk about life experiences. Where have you been? What have you tried?
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Bugun hayotiy tajriba haqida gaplashamiz. Qayerda bo‘lgansiz? Nimalarni sinab ko‘rgansiz?

scenes.title: Tajriba nima?
scenes.say_native: Present perfect zamoni hayotiy tajribani aytish uchun kerak. Biz bu yerda voqea aynan qachon bo‘lganini aytmaymiz, chunki muhimi — sizda shunday tajriba bor. Masalan, “I have visited London” degani Londonda bo‘lganman, qachon ekani muhim emas. Hozirgi hayotingizga bog‘langan o‘tmish haqida gapiryapsiz.
scenes.say: I have visited London. She has tried sushi. The time is not important. The experience is important.
scenes.say_uz: Men Londonda bo‘lganman. U sushini tatib ko‘rgan. Vaqt muhim emas. Tajriba muhim.

scenes.title: Shakli: have + V3
board: I / you / we / they + have + V3
scenes.say_native: Shakli juda oddiy: yordamchi fe’l “have” yoki “has”, keyin fe’lning uchinchi shakli, ya’ni past participle. I, you, we, they bilan “have” ishlatamiz. He, she, it bilan esa “has”. Muntazam fe’llarda uchinchi shakl o‘tgan zamon shakli bilan bir xil, oxiriga “-ed” qo‘shiladi: visited, worked, lived, tried.
scenes.say: I have worked here. She has worked here. Regular verbs: add ed. Visited, lived, tried.
scenes.say_uz: Men shu yerda ishlaganman. U shu yerda ishlagan. Muntazam fe’llar: ed qo‘shiladi. Visited, lived, tried.

scenes.title: Muntazam fe’llar imlosi
scenes.say_native: “-ed” qo‘shganda imlo qoidalarini eslang. E bilan tugasa, faqat “d” qo‘shamiz: live — lived. Undosh plus y bilan tugasa, y “i” ga aylanadi: try — tried. Qisqa bir bo‘g‘inli fe’lda undosh ikkilanadi: stop — stopped. Bular o‘tgan zamon bilan bir xil, shuning uchun sizga tanish bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say: Live, lived. Try, tried. Stop, stopped. I have tried it.
scenes.say_uz: Live, lived. Try, tried. Stop, stopped. Men buni sinab ko‘rganman.

scenes.title: Noto‘g‘ri fe’llar: birinchi guruh
scenes.say_native: Noto‘g‘ri fe’llarning uchinchi shakli ko‘pincha o‘tgan zamon shaklidan farq qiladi, shuning uchun uni alohida yodlash kerak. Mana birinchi guruh: be — been, do — done, see — seen, eat — eaten, take — taken, go — gone. Diqqat qiling: “saw” va “seen” boshqa so‘zlar. Present perfectda faqat uchinchi shakl ishlatiladi: I have seen, emas I have saw.
scenes.say: Be, been. Do, done. See, seen. Eat, eaten. Take, taken. Go, gone.
scenes.say_uz: Be, been. Do, done. See, seen. Eat, eaten. Take, taken. Go, gone.

scenes.title: Noto‘g‘ri fe’llar: ikkinchi guruh
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi guruh: write — written, speak — spoken, drive — driven, fly — flown. Bu yerda uchinchi shakl “-n” bilan tugaydi. Meet — met, buy — bought: bu yerda ikkinchi va uchinchi shakl bir xil. Read esa yozilishi o‘zgarmaydi, lekin uchinchi shakli “red” deb o‘qiladi. Har kuni besh-oltita fe’lni takrorlab yuring.
scenes.say: Written, spoken, driven, flown. Met, bought. And read, spelled the same, but said red.
scenes.say_uz: Written, spoken, driven, flown. Met, bought. Read esa xuddi shunday yoziladi, lekin red deb o‘qiladi.

scenes.title: Uchinchi shaklni ayting
scenes.say_native: Endi mashq. Men fe’lni aytaman, siz uning uchinchi shaklini baland ovozda ayting: see, eat, write, fly, buy, meet. Shoshilmang, har birini aniq talaffuz qiling.
scenes.say: See. Eat. Write. Fly. Buy. Meet.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘rmoq. Yemoq. Yozmoq. Uchmoq. Sotib olmoq. Uchrashmoq.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: see — seen, eat — eaten, write — written, fly — flown, buy — bought, meet — met. Agar “writed” yoki “eated” deb o‘ylagan bo‘lsangiz, tashvishlanmang, bu juda keng tarqalgan xato. Noto‘g‘ri fe’lga “-ed” qo‘shib bo‘lmaydi. Ularni ro‘yxatdan yodlash kerak.
scenes.say: Seen. Eaten. Written. Flown. Bought. Met.
scenes.say_uz: Seen. Eaten. Written. Flown. Bought. Met.

scenes.title: Qisqartmalar va inkor
board: I have = I've, she has = she's
scenes.say_native: Og‘zaki nutqda qisqartma ishlatamiz: I have — I’ve, you have — you’ve, she has — she’s. Inkor shakli: have not — haven’t, has not — hasn’t. Masalan, “I haven’t tried it” — men buni sinab ko‘rmaganman. E’tibor bering: she’s ham “she is”, ham “she has” bo‘lishi mumkin. Qaysi ekanini keyingi so‘zdan bilasiz: she’s been — bu “has”.
scenes.say: I've seen it. She hasn't tried it. We haven't been there.
scenes.say_uz: Men buni ko‘rganman. U buni sinab ko‘rmagan. Biz u yerda bo‘lmaganmiz.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan taqqoslash
board: Men Londonga borganman = I have been to London
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida tajribani “-gan” qo‘shimchasi bilan aytamiz: borganman, ko‘rganman, yeganman. Inglizcha present perfect aynan shu ma’noni beradi. Farqi shundaki, ingliz tilida bu qo‘shimcha emas, ikki so‘zdan iborat shakl: have va uchinchi shakl. Shuning uchun “have” ni tushirib qoldirmang: “I seen” emas, “I have seen”.
scenes.say: I have eaten plov. In Uzbek, you say yeganman. In English, say have eaten.
scenes.say_uz: Men palov yeganman. O‘zbekcha yeganman deymiz. Inglizchada have eaten deymiz.

scenes.title: Have yoki has?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato: have va has ni adashtirish. He, she, it bilan faqat “has”: she has been. I, you, we, they bilan “have”: I have seen. O‘zbek tilida bunday farq yo‘q, shuning uchun qo‘l o‘rganmagan. Ikkinchi xato: has dan keyin fe’lning ikkinchi shaklini qo‘yish. To‘g‘risi — “has gone”, emas “has went”.
scenes.say: She has been to Paris. I have seen it. He has gone, not has went.
scenes.say_uz: U Parijda bo‘lgan. Men buni ko‘rganman. U ketgan, has went emas.

scenes.title: Gap tuzing
scenes.say_native: Mana uchta gap uchun so‘zlar. Ularni present perfect shaklida to‘liq gapga aylantiring. Birinchisi: I, visit, Samarkand. Ikkinchisi: she, eat, sushi. Uchinchisi: they, not, see, that film. Qisqartmalarni ishlatsangiz bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: One. I, visit, Samarkand. Two. She, eat, sushi. Three. They, not, see, that film.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Men, Samarqandga borish. Ikki. U, sushi yeyish. Uch. Ular, u filmni ko‘rmaslik.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — I have visited Samarkand. Ikkinchi — she has eaten sushi, “eaten” ga e’tibor bering. Uchinchi — they haven’t seen that film, bu yerda “seen”. Uchala gapda ham “have” yoki “has” bor va fe’l uchinchi shaklda turibdi. Mana shu formula barcha tajriba gaplarining asosi.
scenes.say: I have visited Samarkand. She has eaten sushi. They haven't seen that film.
scenes.say_uz: Men Samarqandda bo‘lganman. U sushi yegan. Ular u filmni ko‘rmagan.

scenes.title: Savol: Have you ever ...?
board: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

examples.t: Have you ever flown in a plane?

scenes.say_native: Savol tuzish uchun “have” ni gap boshiga olib chiqamiz: Have you ever visited London? Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I have yoki No, I haven’t. Javobda fe’lni takrorlamaymiz, faqat “have” ni aytamiz. Uchinchi shaxsda: Has she ever flown? Yes, she has. Bu savol suhbatni boshlashning eng yaxshi usullaridan biri.
scenes.say: Have you ever flown in a plane? Yes, I have. No, I haven't. Has she ever flown? Yes, she has.
scenes.say_uz: Siz hech samolyotda uchganmisiz? Ha, uchganman. Yo‘q, uchmaganman. U hech uchganmi? Ha, uchgan.

scenes.title: Ever nimani bildiradi?
board: ever gapda have bilan V3 orasida

examples.t: Have you ever met a famous person?
Has he ever been to Japan?

scenes.say_native: “Ever” so‘zi “hayotingizda biror marta” degan ma’noni bildiradi. U asosan savolda ishlatiladi va have bilan uchinchi shakl o‘rtasiga tushadi: Have you ever tried it? Shuning uchun uni alohida tarjima qilish shart emas: savolning umumiy ma’nosi — “hech”, “umringizda”. Ijobiy gapda ever odatda ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: Have you ever met a famous person? Has he ever been to Japan?
scenes.say_uz: Hech mashhur odam bilan uchrashganmisiz? U hech Yaponiyada bo‘lganmi?

scenes.title: Never: hech qachon
scenes.say_native: “Never” — hech qachon. Bu “not ever” ning qisqa shakli, shuning uchun gapda boshqa inkor kerak emas. I have never seen snow — men hech qachon qor ko‘rmaganman. Joylashuvi: have bilan uchinchi shakl o‘rtasida. O‘zbek tilida ikkita inkor ishlatish mumkin, ingliz tilida esa yo‘q: bitta gapda faqat bitta inkor bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: I have never seen snow. She has never been late. We have never met.
scenes.say_uz: Men hech qachon qor ko‘rmaganman. U hech qachon kechikmagan. Biz hech uchrashmaganmiz.

scenes.title: Never bilan ikkinchi inkor
board: ✓ Have you ever gone / been there?
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. Birinchisi: never bilan haven’t ni birga qo‘yish. “I haven’t never” noto‘g‘ri. Yoki “I have never been”, yoki “I haven’t ever been” deng. Ikkinchi xato: ever dan keyin ikkinchi shaklni ishlatish. “Have you ever went” emas, to‘g‘risi — “Have you ever gone” yoki “been”. Har doim uchinchi shakl.
scenes.say: I have never been there. Or: I haven't ever been there. Have you ever eaten snails?
scenes.say_uz: Men u yerda hech bo‘lmaganman. Yoki: men u yerda hech bo‘lmaganman. Hech shilliq qurt yeganmisiz?

scenes.title: Necha marta?

examples.t: I have been to Turkey twice.
She has seen it three times.

scenes.say_native: Tajribada nechta marta bo‘lganini ham aytish mumkin. Bir marta — once, ikki marta — twice, uch va undan ko‘p — three times, four times. Ko‘p marta — many times. Bu so‘zlar odatda gap oxirida turadi: I have been to Turkey twice. Bu bilan siz gapingizni aniqroq va qiziqarliroq qilasiz. Bir marta uchun “one time” demaymiz, “once” deymiz.
scenes.say: I have been to Turkey twice. She has seen it three times. I have tried it once.
scenes.say_uz: Men Turkiyada ikki marta bo‘lganman. U buni uch marta ko‘rgan. Men buni bir marta sinab ko‘rganman.

scenes.title: Savol va javob
board: 1) Have you ever flown in a plane?
3) Have you ever been to London?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta savolga o‘zingiz haqingizda to‘liq javob bering. Avval qisqa javob: Yes, I have yoki No, I haven’t. Keyin bitta gap qo‘shing: I have never flown, yoki I have eaten sushi twice. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Have you ever flown in a plane? Have you ever eaten sushi? Have you ever been to London?
scenes.say_uz: Siz hech samolyotda uchganmisiz? Hech sushi yeganmisiz? Londonda bo‘lganmisiz?

scenes.title: Javob namunalari
board: Yes, I have. I've flown twice.
No, I haven't. I've never eaten sushi.
No, I haven't. I've never been to London.
scenes.say_native: Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, bu normal. Mana namuna: Yes, I have, I’ve flown twice. No, I haven’t, I’ve never eaten sushi. No, I haven’t, I’ve never been to London. Muhim tuzilma: avval qisqa javob, keyin tafsilot. Shunda suhbat quruq “yes” yoki “no” bilan tugab qolmaydi.
scenes.say: Yes, I have. I've flown twice. No, I haven't. I've never eaten sushi.
scenes.say_uz: Ha, uchganman. Ikki marta uchganman. Yo‘q, hech sushi yemaganman.

scenes.title: Been va gone
board: has gone to = ketgan, hozir o‘sha yerda
scenes.say_native: Go fe’lining uchinchi shakli ikkita: been va gone. Ma’nolari farq qiladi. “Been to” — borib, qaytib kelgan. Bu tajriba. “Gone to” — ketgan va hozir o‘sha yerda yoki yo‘lda. Masalan, “She has been to Paris” — u Parijda bo‘lgan, endi bu yerda. “She has gone to Paris” — u hozir Parijda. Tajriba haqida gapirganda odatda “been” kerak.
scenes.say: She has been to Paris. She is back. She has gone to Paris. She is there now.
scenes.say_uz: U Parijda bo‘lgan. U qaytgan. U Parijga ketgan. U hozir o‘sha yerda.

scenes.title: Been yoki gone?
board: 1) Tom isn't here. He has ___ to the bank.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Bo‘sh joyga been yoki gone qo‘ying. Birinchi: Tom bu yerda yo‘q, u bankka ketgan. Ikkinchi: men Ispaniyada ikki marta bo‘lganman. Uchinchi: Anna qani? U uyga ketib qolgan. Har gapda Tom yoki Anna hozir qayerda ekanini o‘ylang.
scenes.say: One. Tom isn't here. He has blank to the bank. Two. I have blank to Spain twice. Three. Where's Anna? She has blank home.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Tom bu yerda yo‘q. U bankka ketgan. Ikki. Men Ispaniyada ikki marta bo‘lganman. Uch. Anna qani? U uyga ketgan.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — gone, chunki Tom hozir bu yerda yo‘q. Ikkinchi — been, chunki siz Ispaniyada bo‘lib, qaytib kelgansiz. Uchinchi — gone, Anna hozir uyda. Qoida: odam hozir o‘sha yerda bo‘lsa — gone, borib qaytgan bo‘lsa — been. Yodda tuting.
scenes.say: One, gone. Two, been. Three, gone.
scenes.say_uz: Bir, gone. Ikki, been. Uch, gone.

scenes.title: Present perfect va past simple
board: I have been to Rome. / I went to Rome in 2019.
scenes.say_native: Endi eng muhim farq. Voqea qachon bo‘lgani aytilmasa yoki muhim bo‘lmasa — present perfect: I have been to Rome. Agar aniq vaqt aytilsa — o‘tgan zamon, past simple: I went to Rome in 2019. Muhim: o‘zbekchada ikkalasini ham “borganman” deymiz, lekin inglizchada aniq vaqt bilan faqat past simple ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: I have been to Rome. I went to Rome in 2019.
scenes.say_uz: Men Rimda bo‘lganman. Men 2019-yilda Rimga borganman.

scenes.title: Vaqt so‘zlari
board: Past simple: yesterday, last year, in 2019, two days ago, when
Present perfect: ever, never, before, once, twice
scenes.say_native: Qaysi zamonni tanlashga vaqt so‘zlari yordam beradi. Yesterday, last year, in 2019, two days ago, when — bular aniq vaqtni bildiradi va past simple talab qiladi. Ever, never, before, once, twice — bular aniq vaqtsiz tajribani bildiradi va present perfectga mos. “Before” — ilgari, aniq qachonligi aytilmagan. Bu so‘zlarni guruhlab yodlang.
scenes.say: Yesterday, last year, ago: past simple. Ever, never, before: present perfect.
scenes.say_uz: Yesterday, last year, ago: past simple. Ever, never, before: present perfect.

scenes.title: Aniq vaqt bilan perfect yo‘q
board: ✗ I have been to Rome in 2019.
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: aniq vaqt so‘zi bilan present perfect ishlatish. “I have seen him yesterday” noto‘g‘ri, chunki yesterday — aniq vaqt. To‘g‘risi: I saw him yesterday. Xuddi shunday, “in 2019”, “last year”, “two days ago” bilan faqat past simple. O‘zbek tilida bunday cheklov yo‘q, shuning uchun siz bunga ongli e’tibor berishingiz kerak.
scenes.say: I saw him yesterday. I went to Rome in 2019. I have never been to Rome.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni kecha ko‘rdim. Men 2019-yilda Rimga bordim. Men Rimda hech bo‘lmaganman.

scenes.title: Zamonni tanlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri zamonda yozing: past simple yoki present perfect. Vaqt so‘zlariga qarang: last week, twice, in 2015, never. To‘rtta gapni baland ovozda aytib chiqing.
scenes.say: One. I see that film last week. Two. I see that film twice. Three. She live in Moscow in 2015. Four. She never live abroad.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Men u filmni o‘tgan hafta ko‘rdim. Ikki. Men u filmni ikki marta ko‘rganman. Uch. U 2015-yilda Moskvada yashagan. To‘rt. U hech qachon chet elda yashamagan.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — I saw that film last week, chunki last week aniq vaqt. Ikkinchi — I have seen that film twice, tajriba va son. Uchinchi — she lived in Moscow in 2015, aniq yil bor. To‘rtinchi — she has never lived abroad, hayotiy tajriba. Agar to‘rttasini ham to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, bu mavzuning eng qiyin joyini o‘zlashtirdingiz.
scenes.say: I saw that film last week. I have seen that film twice. She lived in Moscow in 2015. She has never lived abroad.
scenes.say_uz: Men u filmni o‘tgan hafta ko‘rdim. Men u filmni ikki marta ko‘rganman. U 2015-yilda Moskvada yashagan. U hech qachon chet elda yashamagan.

scenes.title: Ikki zamonni birga ishlatish
board: I've been to Italy. I went in May. It was great.

examples.t: I've been to Italy. I went with my sister.
examples.uz: Men Italiyada bo‘lganman. Opam bilan borgandim.

scenes.say_native: Haqiqiy suhbatda ikkala zamon birga ishlatiladi. Avval present perfect bilan umumiy tajribani aytasiz: I’ve been to Italy. Keyin tafsilotlarga o‘tganda past simple ishlatasiz: I went in May, I went with my sister, it was great. Ya’ni tajriba — perfectda, qachon, qayerda, kim bilan, qanday bo‘ldi — o‘tgan zamonda. Bu qoida suhbatingizni tabiiy qiladi.
scenes.say: I've been to Italy. I went in May. I went with my sister. It was great.
scenes.say_uz: Men Italiyada bo‘lganman. May oyida bordim. Opam bilan bordim. Ajoyib edi.

scenes.title: Dialog: sayohat
board: A: Have you ever been to Turkey?
B: Yes, I have. I went there last summer.
B: Yes! The food was amazing. I've never eaten so much!
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki do‘st sayohat haqida gaplashadi. Birinchisi Turkiyada bo‘lganmi deb so‘raydi. Javob beruvchi tafsilotlarni qaysi zamonda aytayotganiga e’tibor bering. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Have you ever been to Turkey? Yes, I have. I went there last summer. Did you like it? Yes! The food was amazing. I've never eaten so much!
scenes.say_uz: Siz Turkiyada bo‘lganmisiz? Ha, bo‘lganman. O‘tgan yozda borgandim. Yoqdimi? Ha! Ovqat ajoyib edi. Hech qachon bunchalik ko‘p yemaganman!

scenes.title: Dialogni tushundingizmi?
board: 3) What did B think of the food?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: B Turkiyada bo‘lganmi? Ikkinchi: u qachon borgan? Uchinchi: ovqat haqida u nima deydi? Dialogni yodingizga keltiring va to‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: One. Has B been to Turkey? Two. When did B go? Three. What does B think of the food?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. B Turkiyada bo‘lganmi? Ikki. U qachon borgan? Uch. U ovqat haqida nima deydi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — ha, B Turkiyada bo‘lgan. Ikkinchi — o‘tgan yozda, “last summer”, shuning uchun u “went” deydi, “has gone” emas. Uchinchi — ovqat ajoyib bo‘lgan. Ko‘rdingizmi, A dialogni present perfect bilan boshladi, B esa tafsilotga o‘tganda past simple ishlatdi.
scenes.say: Yes, B has. B went last summer. The food was amazing.
scenes.say_uz: Ha, B bo‘lgan. B o‘tgan yozda borgan. Ovqat ajoyib edi.

scenes.title: Davomli savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbatni davom ettirish uchun tafsilot haqida so‘rang. Qachon bordingiz — When did you go? Qayerda turdingiz — Where did you stay? Kim bilan bordingiz — Who did you go with? Qanday edi — What was it like? Yoqdimi — Did you enjoy it? Barcha davomli savollar past simpleda, chunki endi aniq voqea haqida so‘rayapmiz. “What was it like” — ko‘rgan narsangiz haqida taassurotni so‘rash uchun juda foydali ibora.
scenes.say: When did you go? Where did you stay? Who did you go with? What was it like?
scenes.say_uz: Qachon bordingiz? Qayerda turdingiz? Kim bilan bordingiz? U qanday edi?

scenes.title: Davomli savol zamoni
scenes.say_native: Tipik xato: “When” bilan present perfect ishlatish. “When have you been there” noto‘g‘ri, chunki “when” aniq vaqtni so‘raydi. To‘g‘risi: When did you go there? Xuddi shunday, “Where did you stay”. Qoida oddiy: umumiy savol — Have you ever? Aniq savol — When, Where, Who with, What — did bilan.
scenes.say: Have you ever been to Spain? When did you go? Where did you stay?
scenes.say_uz: Siz Ispaniyada bo‘lganmisiz? Qachon bordingiz? Qayerda turdingiz?

scenes.title: Davomli savol tuzing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Do‘stingiz aytdi: I’ve seen the Eiffel Tower. Siz uchta davomli savol bering, uchalasi ham past simpleda: When, Who va What bilan boshlanadigan. Masalan, qachon ko‘rdi, kim bilan ko‘rdi, u qanday edi. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I've seen the Eiffel Tower. Ask three questions. When. Who. What.
scenes.say_uz: Men Eyfel minorasini ko‘rganman. Uchta savol bering. Qachon. Kim. Nima.

scenes.title: Javob namunalari
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar: When did you see it? Who did you go with? What was it like? Sizning savollaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, masalan, “Did you go up the tower?” Asosiysi — past simple va did ishlatish. Fe’l “did” dan keyin asosiy shaklda keladi: did you see, did you go.
scenes.say: When did you see it? Who did you go with? What was it like?
scenes.say_uz: Uni qachon ko‘rdingiz? Kim bilan bordingiz? U qanday edi?

scenes.title: Dialog: yangi tajribalar
board: A: Have you ever tried climbing?
B: No, I haven't, but I'd like to.
A: I've done it twice. I tried it in Georgia.
A: A little. But I loved it.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki hamkasb sport haqida gaplashadi. Kim tajribaga ega va kim yo‘q, buni diqqat bilan tinglang. Shuningdek, “I’d like to” iborasini eshiting. Bu “xohlardim” degan ma’noni beradi.
scenes.say: Have you ever tried climbing? No, I haven't, but I'd like to. I've done it twice. I tried it in Georgia. Was it difficult? A little. But I loved it.
scenes.say_uz: Hech toqqa chiqishni sinab ko‘rganmisiz? Yo‘q, lekin xohlardim. Men ikki marta qilganman. Gruziyada sinab ko‘rganman. Qiyin edimi? Biroz. Lekin menga yoqdi.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 2) How many times has A done it?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: kim toqqa chiqishni sinab ko‘rgan? Ikkinchi: A buni necha marta qilgan? Uchinchi: A buni qayerda sinab ko‘rgan? Dialogni eslab, to‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: One. Who has tried climbing? Two. How many times has A done it? Three. Where did A try it?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Kim toqqa chiqishni sinab ko‘rgan? Ikki. A buni necha marta qilgan? Uch. A buni qayerda sinab ko‘rgan?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — A sinab ko‘rgan, B esa yo‘q. Ikkinchi — ikki marta, twice. Uchinchi — Gruziyada, in Georgia. E’tibor bering: A “I’ve done it twice” deydi, ya’ni perfect, keyin “I tried it in Georgia” — endi aniq joy, shuning uchun past simple.
scenes.say: A has tried climbing. A has done it twice. A tried it in Georgia.
scenes.say_uz: A toqqa chiqishni sinab ko‘rgan. A buni ikki marta qilgan. A buni Gruziyada sinab ko‘rgan.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: tez nutqda
scenes.say_native: Tez nutqda “have” zaif shaklga o‘tadi. Savolda “have you ever” taxminan “əv yu evə” kabi eshitiladi, bunda “h” deyarli aytilmaydi. “I’ve” bir bo‘g‘inli: aiv. “Been” sekin aytilganda biin, uzun “i”, tez nutqda esa ko‘pincha bin, qisqa. Urg‘u esa ma’noli so‘zlarga tushadi: fe’lning uchinchi shakli va ever.
scenes.say: Have you ever tried it? I've been there. I've never seen it.
scenes.say_uz: Hech sinab ko‘rganmisiz? Men u yerda bo‘lganman. Men buni hech ko‘rmaganman.

scenes.title: Tez va tabiiy ayting
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta gapni tabiiy tezlikda takrorlang. Avval sekin, keyin tezroq. Have you ever tried it. I’ve never been there. She’s seen it twice. Yodda tuting: “have” va “has” zaif, asosiy so‘zlar kuchli.
scenes.say: Have you ever tried it? I've never been there. She's seen it twice.
scenes.say_uz: Hech sinab ko‘rganmisiz? Men u yerda hech bo‘lmaganman. U buni ikki marta ko‘rgan.

scenes.title: Talaffuz bo‘yicha tavsiya
scenes.say_native: Siz uchala gapni aytdingiz. Endi bir maslahat: agar “have” ni juda aniq, uzun qilib aytsangiz, nutq robotga o‘xshab qoladi. Uni qisqa qiling, asosiy so‘zni, ya’ni fe’lning uchinchi shaklini esa biroz kuchliroq aytib turing. Telefoningizga yozib olib, o‘zingizni tinglang. Bu eng tez o‘sish usuli.
scenes.say: Say have short. Say tried, been and seen strong.
scenes.say_uz: Have ni qisqa ayting. Tried, been va seen ni kuchli ayting.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: o‘zingiz haqingizda
board: 2) Have you ever tried a new food?
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. O‘zingiz haqingizda gapiring. Birinchi savol: chet elda bo‘lganmisiz? Ikkinchi: yangi taomni sinab ko‘rganmisiz? Uchinchi: nimani hech qachon qilmagansiz? Har biriga javob bering va kamida bitta tafsilotni past simple bilan qo‘shing.
scenes.say: Have you ever been abroad? Have you ever tried a new food? What have you never done?
scenes.say_uz: Chet elda bo‘lganmisiz? Yangi taomni sinab ko‘rganmisiz? Nimani hech qachon qilmagansiz?

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I've been abroad twice. I went to Turkey in 2022.
I've tried sushi. I tried it last year.
I've never flown in a helicopter.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. I’ve been abroad twice. I went to Turkey in 2022. I’ve tried sushi, I tried it last year. I’ve never flown in a helicopter. Ko‘rdingizmi: birinchi gap perfect, ikkinchi gap esa past simple. Sizning javobingiz shu tuzilmaga o‘xshasa, vazifani to‘g‘ri bajardingiz.
scenes.say: I've been abroad twice. I went to Turkey in 2022. I've tried sushi. I've never flown in a helicopter.
scenes.say_uz: Men chet elda ikki marta bo‘lganman. 2022-yilda Turkiyaga bordim. Men sushi sinab ko‘rganman. Hech qachon vertolyotda uchmaganman.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: tajriba — have yoki has va uchinchi shakl. Ikkinchi: ever savolda, never inkor ma’noda, ikkinchi inkor kerak emas. Uchinchi: been — borib qaytgan, gone — hozir o‘sha yerda. To‘rtinchi: aniq vaqt bo‘lsa, past simple. Beshinchi: davomli savollar did bilan beriladi. Siz bugun hayotiy tajribangiz haqida gapirishni o‘rgandingiz.
scenes.say: Have plus third form. Ever in questions. Never for no. Exact time: past simple.
scenes.say_uz: Have plus uchinchi shakl. Ever savolda. Never inkor uchun. Aniq vaqt: past simple.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Ask and answer 8 Have you ever ...? questions
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: sakkizta “Have you ever” savolini yozing va har biriga o‘zingiz javob bering. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida to‘rtta javobda tafsilot past simpleda bo‘lsin, ikkita gapda never ishlatilsin. Savollarni do‘stingiz bilan ham so‘rab ko‘ring. Keyingi darsda e’lonlar va dialoglarni tinglashni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to write eight Have you ever questions and answer them.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: sakkizta Have you ever savolini yozing va ularga javob bering.

homework_uz: Sakkizta “Have you ever...?” savolini yozing va har biriga o‘zingiz javob bering. Kamida to‘rtta javobda past simpleda tafsilot qo‘shing va ikkita gapda never ishlating.

quiz.why_uz: Present perfectda uchinchi shakl kerak: eaten.

When bilan past simple, did ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Choose the correct short answer: Has she ever flown?
They ___ that film. They don't know the story.

Twice tajriba bilan ishlatiladi; boshqalari aniq vaqt.

options: I have go to Rome twice.
I have been to Rome twice.
